meta.name: Iraq — The Women’s Story
meta.description: The United States heralded many grandiose promises of freedom and equal rights as they invaded Iraq. But still years on from the invasion, the reality of everyday life for women inside Iraq is of course a different story. To make this film, two Iraqi women risk their lives to spend three months travelling all over the country with a camera to record the lives and experiences of women they meet.Iraq — The Women’s Storyprovides a compelling account of a life inside Iraq that is never seen on news bulletins…
